description: HomeFeed is a customizable RSS feed widget HomeFeed is a clean, modern, and highly customizable RSS and Atom feed widget for your Android home screen. Stay informed with news, articles, and updates from your favorite sources without constantly opening apps. Key Features: • Multi-Feed Support: Aggregate multiple RSS and Atom feeds into a single, unified stream on your home screen. • Distraction-Free Reader: Read article content instantly in an integrated reader popup, or open full articles in your browser or Chrome Custom Tabs. • Rich Media & Thumbnails: Automatically extracts high-resolution article images and media enclosures. • Material You Design: Full support for Material 3 and dynamic theming, automatically adapting to your system wallpaper and dark/light mode. Customization & Layout: • Layout Modes: Choose between full image cards or a space-efficient Compact Mode with customizable thumbnail positioning (left or right). • Typography & Colors: Pick your preferred font family (Sans-serif, Serif, Monospace) and customize title and description text colors to suit your home screen aesthetic. • Widget Appearance: Adjust background opacity, corner radius, item spacing, and header visibility. • Article Controls: Toggle descriptions, trim length, or show article source labels. Reading Management: • Read Status Filtering: Convenient in-widget header control lets you toggle between showing, dimming, or hiding read articles. • Tap-to-Read: Track what you've read effortlessly with automatic status updates. Smart Sync & Performance: • Battery-Friendly Sync: Set automatic background refresh intervals and define active hours to prevent syncing while you sleep. • Quick Manual Refresh: On-demand refresh button right on the widget header. • Privacy-First & Offline: Feeds and articles are cached locally on your device with zero tracking and minimal resource usage.
